comments: cef1b57b: This section of the code is responsible for generating the totals page by division, including setting up the page header and iterating over all divisions to display their respective delinquency totals.
272e8f5e: Iterate over each total, displaying the division and its delinquent total formatted to the right.
76d143f6: End of the main routine.
1bab6aff: Prints the header for the totals page, including column titles for division and total delinquencies.
465cd7cd: Advance to ensure there are at least 3 lines available on the page before continuing.
8a3b9e11: Retrieve and display the total delinquencies for the division if available.
53d25a43: Check if the output is to a terminal device.
cc32eea3: Prompt the user to press Enter to continue or ^ to quit, handling device timeout.
d9db2bd8: Reset page number to 0 if the division has changed.
30874f87: Print the report header, including the report type and date, and increment the page number.
5bdde1f2: If sorting by event date, format the header to include event date, patient name, and patient ID columns.
68815e51: If not sorting by event date, format the header to include patient name, patient ID, and event date columns.
4ce22aa6: Print the fixed part of the header including discharge type, location, and borrower.
133eeb99: If not sorting by physician, include physician name in the header and conditionally the status if the direction is 2, along with the total days.
8c23a080: If sorting by physician, adjust the header to include type and optionally status if the direction is 2, along with the total days.
fcbad9ca: End of the header printing routine.
87a9399b: Clear patient and report related variables to clean up before exit.
a4464200: Clear additional variables used in the report generation and display.
3018ce56: Clear leftover variables and close the namespace used for temporary storage.
560a45d4: Perform any necessary cleanup operations before quitting the program, such as closing files or devices.
bb463018: Output a separator and the count of unprocessed tasks for the physician, prompting for continuation if not outputting to a terminal.
21a51925: Output a separator and the count of unprocessed tasks for the service, for a specific task within a division.
c45cbcd8: Output a separator and the subtotal for the service within the division and prompt for continuation if not outputting to a terminal.
365ada6b: End of the service subtotal routine.
47b5f6c5: Display the abbreviated discharge type if available.
428facb2: Conditionally display the status abbreviation if direction is set to 2 and status is available.
25e247ab: Print the total number of delinquent days, formatted to the right.
3426d723: End of the line item printing routine.
